action_input.sql:
SELECT
  m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM 'csv/member.csv' AS m
JOIN (SELECT r.zip_code, r.state FROM (SELECT unnest(records) AS r FROM read_json_auto('json/zip_code.json')) AS t) AS z
  ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE
  z.state = 'Illinois';
